summary: /work/ProofDeploy is now a real deploy repo in D12's layout on phase/009-P5a: chart/ carries the tf-presync hook include, the sync-wave -1 / Prune=false Namespace, a ConfigMap that distinguishes a stage value from a chart default (R10) and echoes the synced SHA (R11), and one pinned busybox workload; terraform/ manages the app namespace (a PreSync hook precedes the chart's own, close-out B10) and a Secret in it, with both deliberate failures as committed switches — proof.breakSync in the stage values and break_apply as a Terraform precondition. The repo earns its gate: .kubecoder/project.yaml renders the chart the way the repo-server does and validates the Terraform, 25 mutations each negative-tested to fail; kc project test and kc project lint are green on b265fa3.
